description: List the sounds make_ugc templates play, by beat: where each beat plays, its default and every name it takes. A run plays the defaults; template_sounds { beat: name } swaps a beat's sound, and template_sounds=false plays none. The edit beat plays on every cut only with make_ugc edit_sounds=true. Sounds never change the price. Free.
name: list_template_sounds
title: List template sounds
